title: Meet Our Team | Vertical Wealth
description: Meet the Vertical Wealth team in Indianapolis, including founder Brian Wheeler and wealth advisor Chris Herrmann, your partners in biblical stewardship.

blocks.headline: Your partners in stewardship
blocks.body: Your financial advisor should be more than a number-cruncher. They should be a wise counselor who shares your values. Our team is committed to technical excellence and biblical wisdom, walking alongside you with genuine care.

items.imageAlt: Brian Wheeler, Chief Vision Officer and Financial Planner
items.eyebrow: Chief Vision Officer and Financial Planner
items.title: Brian Wheeler
items.body:
Brian paints the vision for what God will do in and through our clients. He is the lead practice manager for corporate clients and tends to a group of financial planning clients.

As the founder, Brian has been in the financial business since 2000. He started Vertical Wealth in his formal dining room after leaving a larger firm to pursue his dream of creating a fee-based, holistic planning group.

items.title: Chris Herrmann
items.body: Chris is an experienced advisor with more than 25 years in financial planning, sales management, banking, training, investment management and merchant services. He enjoys his daily interaction with clients and colleagues. What spare time he has is dedicated to family and community.

blocks.heading: Grounded in timeless truth
blocks.body: In a world of shifting values, we ground our advice in timeless truth. Our whole process rests on core biblical principles that shape how we see wealth, purpose and stewardship.

blocks.heading: Let's start a conversation
blocks.body: Book a 15-minute, no-pressure discovery call with Brian. Bring your questions; there's no need to bring statements. Not ready yet? Get Weekly Lessons, one short email each week with one idea you can use.
